title: Emergent Matter Research Framework (EMRF): Geometric Interpretations and Reproducible Astronomical Baselines
description: Research software and auditable development records, not a validated fundamental theory. Candidate A investigates a geometric/energy re-description within GR without an additional heating reservoir; no precise functional has yet been author-selected. Real-data work includes SPARC penalized profiles (not Bayesian marginalization), an independently checked single-galaxy influence diagnostic, and covariance-aware Pantheon+/DESI baselines. A baseline fit is not an EMRF cosmology prediction. Earlier releases mislabeled synthetic data and included circular tests; their headline empirical and self-certification claims are withdrawn. Missing regime predictions remain not yet testable. Read README.md, MODEL_CARD.md and docs/EMRF_CANDIDATE_A_FUNCTIONAL_COMPARISON.md for current scope. This file prepares accurate metadata for a separately authorized future archive; it does not state that main has a new DOI or that the historical Zenodo record contains these changes.
